# FG-INT-0024

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`portal-widgets`](../../ops/runbooks/portal-widgets.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failed_service_token_is_portal_token_unavailable` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ポータルへ送るための認証を取得できませんでした。自動で再試行します。
- en: The credentials for sending to the portal could not be obtained. It will be retried automatically.
- id: Kredensial untuk mengirim ke portal tidak dapat diperoleh. Akan dicoba ulang secara otomatis.

## 原因 (cause)

The client-credentials token of the `auth.oidc.client_id` client (ADR-0036: the token endpoint from discovery, `client_secret_basic` with `auth.oidc.client_secret_file`) could not be obtained: the identity provider refused the client (`reason=client_rejected`, with `oauth_error`: the service account is off or the secret is wrong), answered another status (`status`), sent no usable `access_token` or `expires_in` (`invalid_json`), or could not be reached (`unreachable`, with the transport's `detail`). The news attempt fails and is retried (FG-INT-0022).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.portal.service_token_failed` with `reason`, `status`, `oauth_error` and `detail`, never the secret or a token. The `forge doctor` line `auth.oidc` checks discovery.

## 対処 (fix)

Runbook portal-widgets: enable the service account of the gitstation client in realm iotpf (the PFS MR), check the client secret file, then wait for the retry.
